claims.quote: Relative to controls, subgroup 1 showed reduced CSF levels of BACE1, Aβ40, and VAMP2 and higher levels of NfL.

claims.object_text: gradually increased CSF levels of VAMP2 across subgroups 2 to 4
claims.quote: Subgroups 2 to 4 showed gradually increased CSF levels of all measured proteins, either across the first three (NfL and Aβ40) or across all subgroups (VAMP2, NRGN, BACE1).
